q: The degrees of freedom (DoF) of the K-user interference channel gives the pre-log factor of capacity at high SNR. The surprising result by Cadambe-Jafar (2008) showed that the total DoF is:
opts: 1 (as if there were only one user)
K/2 — each user gets half a degree of freedom on average via interference alignment
K — each user gets full DoF
exp: Cadambe-Jafar (2008): the K-user Gaussian interference channel has K/2 total degrees of freedom via interference alignment—each user achieves ½ DoF. This result showed that interference is not the fundamental bottleneck it was believed to be, revolutionising the understanding of interference.
